activity.notes: Rhydderch Hael is not merely a later legendary king: Adomnan's Life of Columba, written around 700, independently attests a king Roderc son of Tothail ruling at Petra Cloithe (Alt Clut), making his historical kingship secure. The broader c.580-c.614 interval comes from reconstruction using later northern British traditions and should remain approximate.

sources.title: Rhydderch Hael — The Heroic Age
sources.citation_text: The study explains that Adomnan's Life of Columba attests Roderc son of Tothail as ruler at Petra Cloithe/Alt Clut and distinguishes this secure evidence from later genealogical and literary material.

sources.title: Rhydderch Hael — ruler of Alt Clut
sources.citation_text: The ruler chronology summarizes Rhydderch's floruit as c.580-c.614 while noting the mix of historical and later medieval evidence.
